repo_remote_url.description: Origin remote URL of the repo this call is about. Supply it when repo_path is a path on another host (a remote member work folder), where git cannot be shelled out. When omitted, scope is derived from repo_path as before.

session_files.description: Files the agent expects to touch this session

hint_modules.description: Module names likely to be relevant

repo_path.description: Repo root for the canonical-bible cold-seed (.fleet/kb-canonical.json). Precedence: this explicit input, when given and valid, wins; otherwise falls back to the validated session working directory; if neither validates, the cold-seed merge is skipped silently.
